hypothesis: Causal earlier-field conditioning can reduce the exact native FX2 finite-coder archive beyond matched parent, bookkeeping, same-field recency and rotated-association controls when the donor is aligned to decoded WRT events.

other_owners_preserved: HORIZON observer and exact running processes

configuration.history: empty at the start of the selected development population; associations enter only after complete valid invocations
configuration.alignment: Feed raw parser bytes only after a complete WRT event is decoded; accept value starts and ends only at event boundaries. Match donor entry WRT capitalization state; never reinterpret raw-byte donors as WRT bytes.
configuration.posterior: Equal prior donor-versus-parent sequence mixture. At each bit combine exact rational donor mass with parent Q16 probability, floor once and clamp 1..65535; update masses only after decoded truth using parent Q16 truth probability. Mismatch removes deterministic donor until next selected value.

arms.P: Unchanged traced native parent Q16 probabilities and native coder.
arms.K: Parent probabilities plus parser and association bookkeeping.
arms.R: Latest completed same-template/same-target-key donor with compatible WRT state.
arms.S: Next FIFO association in the same template/first-key/target-key group, compatible WRT state; abstain with fewer than two.

configuration.source_policy: Existing measured sources remain unchanged. Reuse existing native coder and WRT definitions; new files identify semantic successors. Preserve FX2 authorship.
configuration.selection: One configuration; no parameter sweep. Confirmation remains sealed.

acceptance: Prefix causality including counterfactual future suffix and WRT multibyte/control boundaries.

Exact posterior checks versus independently calculated rational reference, extreme probabilities, donor mismatch and exhaustion.

corpus_gate.scope: Previously examined opening development population only. A separately frozen canonical experiment must bind closed parent trace, dictionary, raw/stored/archive identities, source, ownership, package estimate and measured resource stops before execution.
corpus_gate.evidence_boundary: Replay decoding consumes retained parent probabilities. Even exact replay is a predictive-value diagnostic; no standalone native decoder, complete package, mature-history or full-corpus credit.

stop_rule: One synthetic implementation followed only by an independently admitted frozen corpus gate. Missing exactness, causality, state or provenance is implementation/evidence failure. No treatment opportunities or inactive required controls is inconclusive for conditional value. Nonpositive complete archive savings park this realization without disproof of all field information. No automatic scale or qualification.
